programmes.d: Yandy and Kimbella clear the air, DJ Self hatches an idea to welcome Cisco back to the Creep Squad, and many surprise guests pop up on Juju's girls' trip to Cancun.
Yandy tries to smooth things over with Juju, Rich's daughter Ashley sets him up on a blind date, and Samantha's birthday party for Lil Mendeecees is marred by a commotion.

As Trina embarks on a national tour, family drama threatens her engagement to Raymond. Amara faces her baby shower alone. Sukihana's fan event goes left. Florence and Marlon's single release party ends in disaster.
Amara confronts Allan as her ex-boyfriend Emjay comes back into the picture. Shay Johnson reveals a big secret. Sukihana clashes with Isaiah and Kill Bill. Florence seeks spiritual protection.

Florence faces the haters at the biggest performance of her career. Trina gets in the middle of Raymond and Bobby's conflict. Shay's family gives her the third degree. Amara defies her doctor's orders.

The Hollywood women are forced to pick sides in a war between cliques. Ray J's effort to develop a sexy new image for Bridget Kelly puts a strain on his marriage. Moniece squares off with A.D.'s best friend. Teairra learns the ugly truth about Cisco.

Moniece and Alexis' social media beef spills into the streets. Teairra's behavior at Nikki Baby's event leads to an emotional confrontation. Brooke and Booby cause a stir at Lyrica's listening party. Ray J shows Princess he's ready for fatherhood.

Teairra makes a critical decision about her future. Warring cliques unite in an effort to end the conflict between Masika and Alexis. Marcus confronts Brooke and Booby. Zell sabotages the launch party for Misster Ray's P.R. company.
Rasheeda and her Dad finally find some common ground at the family estate. Scrappy realizes that getting his Mom and Bambi on the same page will be like pulling teeth.
Joc deals with the fallout of Spice's meddling. Momma Dee's latest Shay-dy post causes even more chaos in the palace. Meda throws Spice a pre-Grammy party that has everyone on 10.
Mendeecees makes moves to try and bring his blended family together. The crew heads to Vegas for Grammy week, but Karlie's video shoot has Erica all riled up when Safaree gets rubbed down.

Momma Dee's latest drama leaves Scrappy dead on arrival. Yandy takes a gamble meeting with Samantha & Kisha. Erica calls Karlie's bluff at brunch, but goes all in when she finds out Safaree isn't riding solo in Vegas.

Tears turn to gasps when Safaree brings an uninvited guest to Shekinah's Crying Tour. Scrappy & Bambi try to meet in the middle on Momma Dee. Karlie's surprise pool party makes some waves and sinks her and Sierra's friendship for good.

Grammy night has arrived and Spice's nerves are on TEN. Scrappy has the palace under siege when he finally confronts Momma Dee about her meddling. Erica's divorce saga is finally over, but an unexpected settlement leaves her speechless.

Kirk and Rasheeda deal with the long awaited DNA test results. Stevie clashes with Estelita and tries to replace her with a new first lady of Danger Zone. A new face in the A causes a splash on the scene. Presented by VH1.

The Frost family is shook by Jasmine's pop up at Pressed. Erica mixes it up with old friends, ex friends, and a new love interest. Sierra's smitten with her new boo, but a revelation about her estranged husband leaves her heartbroken.
Drewski attempts to woo Sky back, Swift talks with Cardi B about taking their relationship to the next level, and Yandy, Samantha and Erika meet for the benefit of their kids.
Host Nina Parker and the cast look back at the big moments from the season, check in with Mendeecees and endeavor to withstand more than a few chaotic moments on the stage.
